2.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_A1_000_002
2.translation_description: Esamina la parte superiore del corpo dell'avventuriero.

3.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_A1_000_003
3.translation_description: Esamina la parte inferiore del corpo dell'avventuriero.

7.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_A1_000_007
7.description: Inspect the adventurer from the front.

8.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SYSTEM_700_050
8.description: Take note of any distinguishing features. Many adventurers may look alike at a glance.
8.translation_description: Nota eventuali tratti distintivi. A prima vista, molti avventurieri si somigliano.

9.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SYSTEM_700_051
9.description: Make certain that the adventurer is your client's exact double before you act!
9.translation_description: Prima di agire, assicurati che l'avventuriero sia identico al tuo committente!

10.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM01_000_000
10.description: You wish to inspect me more closely? Good, be my guest!
10.translation_description: Vuoi guardarmi più da vicino? Prego, fai pure!

11.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM01_000_001
11.description: I trust you've seen what you need to see? Then I'll leave you to it!
11.translation_description: Hai visto tutto ciò che ti serviva? Allora ti lascio fare!

12.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM02_000_005
12.description: Ah, of course. You'll want to take a good look at me if you're to find that mischief-making monster.
12.translation_description: Ah, certo. Per trovare quel mostro piantagrane, dovrai guardarmi attentamente.

13.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM02_000_006
13.description: Well? Have you all the details you need? Then pray track down that imp!
13.translation_description: Allora? Hai tutti i dettagli che ti servono? Su, mettiti sulle tracce di quel folletto!

14.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM03_000_010
14.description: Ye...ye want to take a long, hard look at me? Well, if it's to catch the imp... But keep yer eyes away from me...me tender regions!
14.translation_description: V-vuoi... vuoi guardarmi per bene? Se serve a catturare quel folletto... Ma bada a non guardarmi... lì... nelle parti delicate!

15.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM03_000_011
15.description: Gotten an eyeful, have ye? Then go and catch the bloody imp!
15.translation_description: Ti sei rifatto gli occhi? Allora vai a catturare quel dannato folletto!

16.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM04_000_015
16.description: You wish to have a proper look at me before you leave? What a marvelous idea!
16.translation_description: Vuoi guardarmi per bene prima di andartene? Che idea meravigliosa!

17.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM04_000_016
17.description: I wish you luck on your search, friend. You're more than welcome to inspect me again should the need arise.
17.translation_description: Buona fortuna nella ricerca, amico. Se dovessi averne bisogno, puoi tornare a esaminarmi.

18.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM05_000_020
18.description: Yes, yes. Take a good look. <hex:021A020203>He<hex:021A020103> is in every way, shape, and form identical to <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>, so it is essential that you memorize my─and, in turn, his─every feature.
18.translation_description: Sì, sì. Guarda bene. <hex:021A020203>Lui<hex:021A020103> è in tutto e per tutto identico a <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>, quindi è essenziale che tu memorizzi ogni mio tratto e, di conseguenza, ogni suo.

19.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERM05_000_021
19.description: And do not leave without inspecting my garments, for they are <hex:021A020203>his<hex:021A020103> garments as well!
19.translation_description: E non andartene senza aver guardato i miei vestiti: sono anche <hex:021A020203>i suoi<hex:021A020103> vestiti!

20.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF01_100_000
20.description: Do what you must, but pray be quick about it! Even as we speak, that fiend could be doing horrible things in my name!
20.translation_description: Fa' pure ciò che devi, ma sbrigati! In questo stesso momento quel demonio potrebbe compiere orribili misfatti a mio nome!

21.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF01_100_001
21.description: You <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> find him, will you not? I dare not consider the alternative...
21.translation_description: Lo <hex:021A020203>troverai<hex:021A020103>, vero? Non oso nemmeno prendere in considerazione l'alternativa...

22.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF02_100_005
22.description: Oh, would you care to see how I'm dressed and such? That should help you find that awful demon.
22.translation_description: Oh, vuoi dare un'occhiata al mio abbigliamento? Potrebbe aiutarti a trovare quel terribile demonio.

23.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF02_100_006
23.description: Well, then, I'll leave you to it! Feel free to come back if you need another look!
23.translation_description: Allora ti lascio fare! Torna pure se vuoi guardarmi di nuovo!

24.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF03_100_010
24.description: Have you found that bleedin' imp yet? Wait, you want to take a look at <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>!?
24.translation_description: Hai già trovato quel maledetto folletto? Aspetta, vuoi guardare proprio <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>!?

25.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF03_100_011
25.description: Keep your eyes peeled, love─a <hex:020810E905FF056D616964FF06626C6F6B6503>'s mum couldn't tell <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> an' the imp apart!
25.translation_description: Tieni gli occhi aperti, tesoro: neanche la mamma di una <hex:020815E905FF08726167617A7A61FF08726167617A7A6F03> saprebbe distinguere <hex:02080DE905FF046C6569FF046C756903> dal folletto!

26.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF04_100_015
26.description: Wait, no! Put that down. I'm the real me, I swear! In fact, why not take a closer look before you go? Can't have you harassing innocent patrons with brightash, now can we?
26.translation_description: Aspetta, no! Rimetti giù quello. Sono io, te lo giuro! Anzi, perché non mi guardi meglio prima di andare? Non vorrai mica molestare gli avventori innocenti con la cenere abbagliante, no?

27.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF04_100_016
27.description: I hope you find that horrible imp, and find him quick. Goodness knows I can't have my reputation sullied before the big tournament.
27.translation_description: Spero che tu trovi presto quel terribile folletto. Non posso certo permettere che la mia reputazione venga infangata prima del grande torneo.

28.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF05_100_020
28.description: Take a close look. Closer now. I wouldn't have you mistaking some disheveled commoner for the second-most beautiful woman in the Saucer.
28.translation_description: Guardami bene. Ancora più da vicino. Non vorrei che scambiassi una persona comune e trasandata per la seconda donna più bella del Gold Saucer.

29.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_MIDLANDERF05_100_021
29.description: Some say the impostor is an <hex:021A020203>exact<hex:021A020103> double, but that would be ridiculous, for we all know by the definition of <hex:021A020203>exact<hex:021A020103> that there is room for variation.
29.translation_description: Si dice che l'impostore sia una copia <hex:021A020203>perfetta<hex:021A020103>, ma sarebbe assurdo: sappiamo tutti che la parola <hex:021A020203>perfetta<hex:021A020103> ammette variazioni.

30.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HIGHLANDER01_200_000
30.description: You want to take a good look at me so you can find me? Gods, why didn't I think of that? Look, then─<hex:021A020203>look<hex:021A020103>!
30.translation_description: Vuoi guardarmi bene per poter trovare me? Dei, perché non ci ho pensato io? Guarda, allora: <hex:021A020203>guardami<hex:021A020103>!

31.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HIGHLANDER01_200_001
31.description: I'm counting on you to stop him─to stop <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>─before it's too late!
31.translation_description: Conto su di te: devi fermarlo, fermare <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>, prima che sia troppo tardi!

32.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HIGHLANDER02_200_005
32.description: We don't want you throwing brightash at the wrong man. Here, you'd best take note of what I'm wearing.
32.translation_description: Non vorremmo che tu gettassi la cenere abbagliante addosso all'uomo sbagliato. Ecco, fai meglio a notare come sono vestito.

34.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HIGHLANDER03_200_010
34.description: Very well. To catch an imp, I will submit myself to your investigation.
34.translation_description: Molto bene. Pur di catturare un folletto, mi sottoporrò al tuo esame.

35.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HIGHLANDER03_200_011
35.description: The voidsent's guise is perfect, my friend. Do not let it make a fool of you.
35.translation_description: Il travestimento della creatura del vuoto è perfetto, amico mio. Non lasciare che ti prenda in giro.

36.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HIGHLANDER04_200_015
36.description: Though my purloined good looks should be unmistakable in a crowd, might I suggest you take one last look at me?
36.translation_description: Anche se i miei lineamenti rubati dovrebbero essere inconfondibili tra la folla, ti suggerisco di guardarmi un'ultima volta.

37.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HIGHLANDER04_200_016
37.description: I hope that imp gets everything that's coming to him. One cannot steal this beautiful face without repercussions, you know.
37.translation_description: Spero che quel folletto riceva quel che si merita. Non si può rubare questo bel viso senza pagarne le conseguenze.

38.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HIGHLANDER05_200_020
38.description: Gawp all ye want, but keep them dirty dukes to yerself.
38.translation_description: Guarda pure quanto ti pare, ma tieni quelle manacce zozze a posto.

39.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HIGHLANDER05_200_021
39.description: Alright! Alright! That's enough. Any more gazin' into me orbs and people might start talkin'.
39.translation_description: Va bene! Va bene! Basta così. Se continui a guardarmi dritto negli occhi, la gente potrebbe mettersi a parlare.

40.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN01_300_000
40.description: Well, if you must. But don't take too long─we haven't much time!
40.translation_description: Se proprio devi. Ma non metterci troppo: il tempo stringe!

41.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN01_300_001
41.description: Take care not to throw it at the first Seeker of the Sun you see. There are more than a few here <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF19020815E3E90C05FF08746F6E69676874FF06746F64617903FF19020815E3E90C12FF06746F646179FF08746F6E696768740303> wearing outfits similar to mine.
41.translation_description: Fai attenzione a non gettare la cenere addosso al primo Cercasole che incontri. Qui ce ne sono parecchi <hex:020837E3E90C0DFF18020814E3E90C05FF0873746173657261FF056F67676903FF18020814E3E90C12FF056F676769FF08737461736572610303> che indossano abiti simili ai miei.

42.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN02_300_005
42.description: Have you found that impish imitator? Or did you wish to appreciate my fine sense of fashion first?
42.translation_description: Hai trovato quel folletto camuffato? O preferivi ammirare prima il mio raffinato gusto nel vestire?

43.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN02_300_006
43.description: The creature copied my style from the top of my head to the tip of my claws, so it shouldn't be too hard to find!
43.translation_description: Quella creatura ha copiato il mio stile dalla testa alla punta degli artigli, quindi non dovrebbe essere difficile trovarla!

44.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN03_300_010
44.description: You want to <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103>? I hardly think I of all people should be subject to your prying eyes.<hex:02100103>...But do as you must.
44.translation_description: Vuoi fare <hex:021A020203>cosa<hex:021A020103>? Io, fra tutti, non dovrei essere sottoposto ai tuoi sguardi indiscreti.<hex:02100103>...Ma fa' pure ciò che devi.

45.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN03_300_011
45.description: Are you satisfied? Good. Now kindly go and find the imp!
45.translation_description: Hai finito? Bene. Ora, per favore, vai a cercare il folletto!

46.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN04_300_015
46.description: If you think it would help, you're more than welcome to another look. Anything to help catch that horrible little monster.
46.translation_description: Se pensi che possa aiutare, puoi guardarmi di nuovo quando vuoi. Pur di catturare quel terribile mostriciattolo.

47.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN04_300_016
47.description: I'm counting on you to teach that imp a lesson. If you need another look at my outfit, I'll be here waiting for you.
47.translation_description: Conto su di te: dai una lezione a quel folletto. Se vuoi riguardare il mio vestito, mi trovi qui.

48.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN05_300_020
48.description: If it means finding that imp, you can eye me all you like!
48.translation_description: Se serve a trovare quel folletto, puoi guardarmi quanto vuoi!

49.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEEKEROFTHESUN05_300_021
49.description: Do take care when using that brightash, however. It seems I am not the only Seeker of the Sun who believes her identity stolen by the imp.
49.translation_description: Fai attenzione, però, quando usi la cenere abbagliante. Pare che non sia l'unica Cercasole qui a credere che il folletto le abbia rubato l'identità.

50.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_WILDWOOD01_400_000
50.description: Did you find him already? What!? You're only here to inspect my garments?
50.translation_description: L'hai già trovato? Cosa!? Sei qui solo per guardare i miei vestiti?

51.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_WILDWOOD01_400_001
51.description: Admittedly, I have been told on several occasions that I resemble someone else, so your caution may be warranted. Still, time is of the essence...
51.translation_description: Ammetto che più volte mi hanno detto che somiglio a qualcun altro, perciò la tua cautela è comprensibile. Però dobbiamo sbrigarci...

52.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_WILDWOOD02_400_005
52.description: I am accustomed to lingering stares, but must you gaze with such intensity? I suppose I must endure the attention if it will aid you in banishing that upstart impostor...
52.translation_description: Sono abituato agli sguardi insistenti, ma devi fissarmi così intensamente? Immagino che sopporterò l'attenzione, se mi aiuterà a scacciare quel presuntuoso impostore...

53.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_WILDWOOD02_400_006
53.description: You may find yourself drawn to other, lesser beauties, but I assure you, none have quite reached the same pinnacle of loveliness as I.
53.translation_description: Potrebbero attirarti altre bellezze, certo inferiori, ma ti assicuro che nessuna raggiunge la mia stessa perfezione.

54.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_WILDWOOD03_400_010
54.description: You would like to take a closer look at my figure? By all means, my friend.
54.translation_description: Vorresti guardarmi più da vicino? Prego, amico mio.

55.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_WILDWOOD03_400_011
55.description: Is there aught else you would see? No? Then may the Twelve aid you in finding the fiend.
55.translation_description: C'è altro che vuoi vedere? No? Allora che i Dodici ti assistano nel trovare il demonio.

56.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_WILDWOOD04_400_015
56.description: If you're going to catch that little monster, you had best take a closer look at my clothing. The last thing we want is to be thrown out for harassing our fellow patrons.
56.translation_description: Per catturare quel mostriciattolo, faresti meglio a guardare da vicino i miei vestiti. L'ultima cosa che vogliamo è farci buttare fuori per aver molestato gli altri avventori.

57.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_WILDWOOD04_400_016
57.description: Imps are a crafty lot, so be careful.
57.translation_description: I folletti sono astuti, quindi fai attenzione.

58.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_WILDWOOD05_400_020
58.description: Commit my features to memory if you must, but be quick about it. My creditors are not the most patient of people.
58.translation_description: Memorizza pure i miei lineamenti, se necessario, ma sbrigati. I miei creditori non hanno molta pazienza.

60.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF01_500_000
60.description: Huh? Er... Ye want me to strike a pose or summat?
60.translation_description: Eh? Ehm... vuoi che mi metta in posa o roba del genere?

61.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF01_500_001
61.description: Satisfied? Off with ye, then! That imp ain't goin' to catch himself!
61.translation_description: Contento? Allora fila! Quel folletto non si catturerà da solo!

62.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF02_500_005
62.description: Ye need to sear me ugly face into yer brain, do ye? Take a good long look, then.
62.translation_description: Devo imprimerti in testa la mia brutta faccia, eh? Allora guardala bene.

63.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF02_500_006
63.description: Remembered all me bumps an' crags? All right, matey. Ye take me smoke bomb an' crack that voidsent bastard right 'twixt the eyes!
63.translation_description: Ti ricordi tutte le mie gobbe e le mie rughe? Bene, compagno. Prendi la mia bomba fumogena e colpisci tra gli occhi quel bastardo della creatura del vuoto!

64.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF03_500_010
64.description: What strange tide landed all these folk what could be me twin here?<hex:02100103>Eh? Ye need to look me over? Look away, mate, look away!
64.translation_description: Che strana marea ha portato qui tutta questa gente, tra cui tanti possibili sosia?<hex:02100103>Eh? Vuoi guardarmi bene? Distogli lo sguardo, amico, distogli lo sguardo!

65.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF03_500_011
65.description: That's...that's all? Well, I've no intent to leave if ye need another look.
65.translation_description: Tutto qui? Beh, non ho intenzione di andarmene se vuoi guardarmi ancora.

66.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF04_500_015
66.description: I reckon you'd be too fast to keep up with. Least I can do, though, is give you a look at my clothes before you go.
66.translation_description: Scommetto che saresti troppo veloce perché io riesca a starti dietro. Posso almeno mostrarti i miei vestiti prima che tu vada.

67.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF04_500_016
67.description: I'll wait here, in case he slips by you. Good luck!
67.translation_description: Ti aspetterò qui, nel caso ti sfugga. Buona fortuna!

68.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF05_500_020
68.description: Like I told ye, the imp has me eyes, me nose, me scars. Hells, the little devil even had the damned decency to monkey me turnout.
68.translation_description: Come ti ho detto, quel folletto ha i miei occhi, il mio naso, le mie cicatrici. Diamine, il diavoletto si è perfino preso la briga di copiare il mio vestiario.

69.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_SEAWOLF05_500_021
69.description: Ye find him for me, eh? I don't know how much longer I can take this.
69.translation_description: Lo troverai per me, eh? Non so per quanto ancora riuscirò a sopportare questa situazione.

70.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD01_600_000
70.description: Ahhh, I knew there was a reason I chose you! Kind <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> clever!
70.translation_description: Ahhh, sapevo che c'era un motivo se ho scelto te! Gentile <hex:021A020203>e<hex:021A020103> intelligente!

71.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD01_600_001
71.description: Just hold my image in your mind's eye! I know you can do it!
71.translation_description: Tieni bene a mente la mia immagine! So che ce la puoi fare!

72.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD02_600_005
72.description: I never paid much attention before, but there's more than a few lads in here that could pass for me at a glance. You've only got one shot, so you'd best be sure of your target.
72.translation_description: Non ci avevo mai fatto caso, ma qui ci sono parecchi ragazzi che a prima vista potrebbero passare per me. Hai una sola occasione, quindi assicurati di scegliere il bersaglio giusto.

73.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD02_600_006
73.description: You'll find that imp, won't you? What if it's out there right now, ordering lunch for a hundred...?
73.translation_description: Lo troverai, vero? E se in questo momento se ne andasse in giro a ordinare il pranzo per cento persone...?

74.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD03_600_010
74.description: Want to look me over, eh? Fine. But not a word about my posture.
74.translation_description: Vuoi squadrarmi, eh? Va bene. Però non dire una parola sulla mia postura.

75.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD03_600_011
75.description: People... Too many people.<hex:02100103>Get that imp, so I can get out of here!
75.translation_description: Persone... troppa gente.<hex:02100103>Trova quel folletto, così posso andarmene!

76.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD04_600_015
76.description: Making a mental note of my appearance should help you track the beast down.
76.translation_description: Memorizzare il mio aspetto dovrebbe aiutarti a rintracciare la bestia.

77.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD04_600_016
77.description: Well, I'll leave you to it, then. If you need anything, you know where to find me.
77.translation_description: Ti lascio fare, allora. Sai dove trovarmi se hai bisogno.

78.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD05_600_020
78.description: Ah, a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> after my own heart. You, too, then realize that only through observation can one answer the riddles of the world. Observe away, my friend.
78.translation_description: Ah, ecco <hex:020817E905FF0A756E6120646F6E6E61FF08756E20756F6D6F03> che la pensa come me. Anche tu, quindi, sai che solo osservando si possono risolvere gli enigmi del mondo. Osserva pure, amico mio.

79.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGATEHIDDENOBJECT_00248_HELLSGUARD05_600_021
79.description: I wish you the best of luck...even though my studies have found that luck plays little part in the outcome of events such as these.
79.translation_description: Ti auguro buona fortuna... anche se i miei studi dimostrano che la fortuna incide ben poco sull'esito di situazioni simili.
